description: Rapid gap analysis for EU DORA (Digital Operational Resilience Act) covering ICT continuity (Art. 11), threat-led penetration testing (Art. 26), and third-party risk (Art. 27). Returns a readiness score and next steps. For a full assessment, direct the user to the linked form.

has_documented_bcp.description: Is there a documented Business Continuity Plan?

has_tlpt_programme.description: Does the org run a Threat-Led Penetration Testing (TLPT) programme?

incident_reporting_process.description: Is there a formal ICT-related incident reporting process?

tests_bcp_annually.description: Is the BCP tested at least once a year?

third_party_register.description: Is there a register of critical third-party ICT providers?

name: dora_readiness_assessment
title: DORA readiness quick-check
